replayScope.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-m3-function-call (read 2026-10-29): "In multi-turn function call conversations, the complete model response (i.e., the assistant message) must be appended to the conversation history to maintain the continuity of the reasoning chain"; "the entire `response_message`, including `reasoning_content`, must be kept in the message history and passed back to the model in the next request. This is essential for achieving the model's best performance." No error is documented for omission.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-m3-function-call (read 2026-10-29): "In multi-turn function call conversations, the complete model response (i.e., the assistant message) must be appended to the conversation history to maintain the continuity of the reasoning chain"; "the entire `response_message`, including `reasoning_content`, must be kept in the message history and passed back to the model in the next request. This is essential for achieving the model's best performance." No error is documented for omission. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
